title: refactor(service-automation): move 14 delete-bearing AutomationEngine bodies into their seam modules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XPa8wo37pD4eagmNazfkued)_

Part of #25222 (slice 8a of the `engine.ts` split; #25222 remains open for slice 8b, `resumeInternal`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim 6391244018 (`domain:server` seat 1). Ruling-ref: 6384677413 (ruling B: slice 8 after the census reader, landed as #25660) and 6348891160 (the series' `.d.ts` bar). Resumed from the trial commit `claude/project-thread-nirtwt@6305caf7` that Release 6385919610 handed over, rebuilt onto `main` `f6ba1343b` and re-proved there.

## What moved

Move-only. The bodies of 14 `AutomationEngine` methods move, token for token, to the end of the seam module that already holds their section. No new module. Each class method keeps its name, docblock, signature and position, and calls its body with a host literal of exactly the members the body reads.

- `dispatch-claims.ts`: `pruneInProcessDispatchClaims`
- `run-resume.ts`: `persistSuspendedRun`, `forgetSuspendedRun`, `evictConsumedSuspension`, `takeSubflowParentStrand`
- `plugin-extension-api.ts`: `unregisterNodeExecutor`, `unregisterTrigger`, `unregisterConnector`
- `flow-definitions.ts`: `unregisterConnectorProvider`, `withdrawFlow`, `hydrateFlowActivations`, `toggleFlow`
- `consumed-suspension-restore.ts`: `journalConsumedSuspension`, `restoreOneConsumedSuspension`

Shape B, as in slices 1 to 7. Methods go to the host as late-bound closures, so a spy set on the instance is still the one called. `store` and `flowActivationStore` go through getters, because `setSuspendedRunStore` and `setFlowActivationStore` reassign them. Every other field goes by value: a grep for `this.FIELD =` over the package source finds only the constructor's `this.logger = logger` among them, so the value passed is the field, including where an async body reads it after an `await`. The five async stubs drop `async` and return the promise the moved function makes. `forgetSuspendedRun` keeps its `durableRecordAlreadyConsumed = false` default in both places. `engine.ts` exports nothing new: the bodies read only names already exported (`IN_PROCESS_DISPATCH_CLAIM_TTL_MS`, `MAX_CONSUMED_SUSPENSIONS`, `buildRunTrigger`, and types).

The six bodies Release 6385919610 names as stays (`execute`, `bubbleToParent`, `registerFlow`, `activateFlowTrigger`, `deactivateFlowTrigger`, `declineOntoDisabledSubflows`) stay, for its reasons. Slice 8b (`resumeInternal`) is a later PR.

## Rebuilt onto current `main`

The trial sat on `9dac9eb8d6`. Since then `main` changed `engine.ts` (#25703 adds the constructor-read field `credentialResolver`) and `flow-definitions.ts` (#25643, #25703). The rebuild is a cherry-pick of `6305caf7` onto `f6ba1343b` with one textual conflict: both sides appended members to `FlowDefinitionsHost` (`credentialResolver` from `main`, ten members from the trial); both are kept. None of the 14 bodies reads `credentialResolver` (measured below), so no host gains it.

## One reader the trial missed: `flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`

The trial's readings did not include vitest. On the rebuilt tree one test went red: the pin "the only writers of the activation projection are hydration and toggleFlow" cuts the engine's sources into members and asks which member writes `flowLedgerDisabled`. It cut on a four-space-indented line, which is a member's name in `engine.ts` but an ordinary statement inside a top-level function, so once `hydrateFlowActivations` and `toggleFlow` moved, the pin cut them mid-body and named a chunk carrying neither name. The pin now cuts a seam module only where a line starts in column 0, and keeps its `engine.ts` split (second commit, test file only). Control: with `this.flowLedgerDisabled.add(name);` injected into the moved `withdrawFlow` body, the pin goes red and names `withdrawFlow`; the file was restored by `git checkout HEAD --` and its hash matched the HEAD blob `f711ccad`.

## Move proof (TypeScript AST, base `f6ba1343b`, head `035ed1efa`)

- All 14 moved functions are token-identical to their base method: AST leaf tokens (kind and text) of the body, the parameters (the head's `this` parameter dropped), the return type and the `async` modifier. Body token counts: 41, 106, 103, 33, 30, 64, 103, 22, 22, 74, 129, 266, 134, 731.
- Negative controls: a one-token on-disk edit in a scratch copy (`rec.at < cutoff` to `rec.at <= cutoff` in `pruneInProcessDispatchClaims`) reads DIFFERENT, and so does an in-memory one-token change to `toggleFlow`.
- Hosts: for each of the 14, the set of `this.X` reads in the moved body equals the `Pick` keys of its `this` type, which equals the keys of the class stub's host literal, and the stub calls the function of its own name. No moved body reads `credentialResolver`.
- Every line deleted from `engine.ts` (590) is found among the modules' added lines, except the five `async` signature lines the stubs drop and the 12 lines of the four rewritten import comments.

## Readers, byte-identical at both ends

Taken in two worktrees, base `f6ba1343b` and head (re-taken on the final head):

- `check-startup-registry-verdict`: 46 seams across 3,491 files, 39 read-only, both ends; `--list` identical apart from `engine.ts` line numbers, so `registerFlow`'s line is unchanged; `--self-test` identical.
- Tenant-audit census: `check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` and its `--self-test` identical (238 write call sites certified, 162 decidable, 23 prose figures, every `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row matched); `tenant-audit-census.mjs` human output identical; `--json` identical apart from its `ref` field, the measured commit.
- `check-system-context-census` and its `--self-test` identical (149 elevation read sites in 77 files, 129 symbols); `isystem-census.mjs --json` identical.
- `check-platform-checklist` (986 of 996 symbol anchors, the 10 on the #16898 residual), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (2,384 anchors across 142 records), `check-adr-anchors`, and spec `check:liveness` (1,187 classified): each output identical.

## `.d.ts` and bundles

- `dist/index.d.ts` is raw byte-identical at both ends, sha256 `a5cbe3bbb8aff2805674e1d9f119946199697e469a3e8a5b9bc7eb4fc08bc7cb` (`index.d.cts` the same bytes), so the ruling's normalised identity holds trivially.
- ESM and CJS export lists: 39 names each, the same list in both bundles, identical at both ends, with each export's `typeof` and function name unchanged.

## Tests and gates (head `035ed1efa`)

- `@objectstack/service-automation` vitest: Test Files 201 passed (201), Tests 2636 passed (2636), the same at base `f6ba1343b`. Package `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`) passes; ESLint over the package is clean.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 60 families on the 7 paths; all 60 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED from recorded exit codes. Two needed a prerequisite first, not a fix: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into this shallow clone, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed the workspace's `dist/` trees.
- `check-governed-merges --branch`: 0 of 7 paths on the register, NOT governed; 1,582 changed lines, under 3,000.
- `skip-changeset`: nothing published changes (the `.d.ts` bytes and the export lists are identical).

## Acceptance notes

- Two comments in moved bodies point by position at text that is now in another file: `unregisterTrigger`'s "see `forgetSuspendedRun`'s catch above" (now in `run-resume.ts`) and `persistSuspendedRun`'s "the docblock above argues it" (the docblock stays on the class method in `engine.ts`). Moved unedited, as slices 1 to 7 did with theirs.
- `main` moved after the base (#25710, #25720); neither touches `packages/services/service-automation`.
